summary.text: Josh Thomas is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 21, which covers part of Prince William County.
Josh Thomas has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Josh Thomas was born in Atlanta, Georgia, in 1987.
Josh Thomas studied at Vanderbilt University (B.A., 2010) and the College of William and Mary (J.D., 2018).
Josh Thomas's listed occupation is attorney.
The profile says Josh Thomas served on active duty in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2010 to 2015 and in the reserve from 2015 to 2018.
The profile lists Mahlet Makonnen as Josh Thomas's spouse.
The House profile lists Josh Thomas's committee assignments as Public Safety, Transportation, and Appropriations.
